This Field Procedure covers the steps required to unlock [[Eleanor Bresa]]. For her workshop, modification roster, and referral relationship with [[Yi Shen]], see the Engineer reference page.

== Objective ==

Gain access to Eleanor Bresa's Odyssey Engineering services at '''Bresa Modifications''' in '''Desy'''.

== Prerequisites ==

{{Prerequisites|
* '''Game mode:''' Live with Odyssey on-foot content available.
* '''Region:''' Reach the [[Colonia]] region.
* '''Discovery:''' Eleanor is common knowledge; no Engineer referral is required.
* '''Unlock target:''' Visit five distinct Odyssey settlements in the '''Colonia system'''.
}}

The requirement refers to the star system named '''Colonia''', not to any five settlements elsewhere in the wider Colonia region.<ref name="inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/38/ INARA: Eleanor Bresa], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Plot a route to the '''Colonia''' star system.
# Open the system map or navigation panel and identify five distinct surface settlements in that system.
# Travel to the first settlement and request docking permission.
# Dock, disembark, and enter the settlement area so the visit can register.
# Repeat the docking and disembarkation process at four other settlements in the Colonia system.
# Check the Engineers panel after the fifth distinct visit.
# If access has not appeared, return to the main menu and begin a new session; INARA notes that services may not update immediately after the requirement is completed.<ref name="inara" />
# Travel to '''Bresa Modifications''' in the '''Desy''' system and confirm that Eleanor's workshop services are available.
}}

An Apex Interstellar shuttle can be used for the settlement circuit when routes are available. Using distinct settlements is important; repeated arrivals at the same site should not be relied upon to advance the count.

== Expected result ==

{{Expected result|[[Eleanor Bresa]] is unlocked and her suit and handheld-weapon modification services are available at Bresa Modifications.}}

No commodity, material donation, rank, faction reputation, or additional workshop payment is required for Eleanor's initial unlock.<ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Eleanor_Bresa Elite Dangerous Wiki: Eleanor Bresa], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

== Troubleshooting ==

;The counter does not advance
:Confirm that every site is inside the '''Colonia''' system, that each settlement is distinct, and that the Commander docked and disembarked rather than only flying nearby.

;The fifth visit is complete but the workshop is unavailable
:Begin a new game session, then recheck the Engineers panel before travelling to Desy.

;Eleanor is unlocked but Yi Shen is not
:Yi has a separate three-part referral. After unlocking Eleanor, provide her with 10 Digital Designs and also complete the referral tasks from [[Baltanos]] and [[Rosa Dayette]]. See [[Unlocking Yi Shen]].
